steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Plane of movement: An imaginary flat surface that divides the body into sections. Movement occurs ALONG or PARALLEL to a plane. | Axis of movement: An imaginary line around which the body or body part rotates. The axis is always PERPENDICULAR (at 90°) to the plane of movement. | Sagittal Plane: Divides the body into left and right halves. Movement in this plane involves flexion and extension - forward and backward movements. | Transverse Axis: Runs from left to right through the body. The body or body parts rotate around this axis when performing flexion and extension movements.

steps.title: Lesson 3: Application
steps.body: Name the three planes of movement and describe how each divides the body. | Which plane and axis are used when performing a forward somersault? | Explain why a cartwheel occurs in the frontal plane around the sagittal axis.

steps.title: Homework & Consolidation
steps.body: Consolidation, retrieval on Plane of movement, Axis of movement, Sagittal Plane, and one past-paper question.
